1.t: Has the story reached thee of the overwhelming (Event)?

2.t: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated,

4.t: The while they enter the Blazing Fire,-

5.t: The while they are given, to drink, of a boiling hot spring,

6.t: No food will there be for them but a bitter Dhari'

7.t: Which will neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.

8.t: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful,

11.t: Where they shall hear no (word) of vanity:

12.t: Therein will be a bubbling spring:

13.t: Therein will be Thrones (of dignity), raised on high,

17.t: Do they not look at the Camels, how they are made?-

18.t: And at the Sky, how it is raised high?-

19.t: And at the Mountains, how they are fixed firm?-

20.t: And at the Earth, how it is spread out?

21.t: Therefore do thou give admonition, for thou art one to admonish.

22.t: Thou art not one to manage (men's) affairs.

23.t: But if any turn away and reject Allah,-

24.t: Allah will punish him with a mighty Punishment,

25.t: For to Us will be their return;

26.t: Then it will be for Us to call them to account.
